name: HerbalBath

what.zh: 外用草本喷雾，主要成分是没药和乳香。喷在身上约10秒感受温热。
what.en: A topical herbal spray made with myrrh and frankincense. Spray on and feel warmth in about 10 seconds.

en: Press with your palm for 10 seconds

product.look: a 60ml amber glass spray bottle with a clear cap and a maroon and cream label, next to its box

audience.zh: 新加坡家庭：喜欢天然、传统产品的55岁以上讲华语的长辈，以及替父母买东西的成年子女。
audience.en: Singapore families: Mandarin-speaking adults 55+ who like natural, traditional products, and their grown-up children who shop for them.

voice.zh: 温暖、朴实、尊重长辈。句子要短，字要大。不夸张，不说医疗功效，不制造焦虑。
voice.en: Warm, plain-spoken, respectful of elders. Short sentences, big type. Never pushy, never medical, never fear-based.

confirm.note: Confirm the customer count before an ad uses it.

story.zh: 没药与乳香是两千年来流传的传统外用香料，HerbalBath 把它们做成了方便每天使用的喷雾。
story.en: Myrrh and frankincense have been treasured as traditional topical ingredients for two thousand years. HerbalBath made them easy to use every day, in a spray.

en: after a long day minding the grandchildren
at the end of a work day

rules: Use the approved claims word for word, or say nothing about effects at all: talk about warmth, the ritual, the tradition, the gift, the offer.
Never address the viewer's body, health, age or condition (no 'your knee pain', no 'are you over 60'); show people instead.
No before-and-after comparisons, no doctors or lab coats, no medical settings, no comparisons with named products.
Show the real product (the photo) whenever the product is on screen; never invent a different bottle or label.
